method.event_time_source: controller swarm_received_at and aware report timestamps; remote buffering/clock latency unmeasured
method.command_matching: Pair item.started/item.completed by local item ID; merge same-task intervals before counting distinct simultaneous tasks.
method.categories: Nonexclusive read/check/write-like string heuristics, not semantic intent or completed feature proof. Explicit canonical doc filename mentions only; wildcard/indirect reads can be missed.
method.repeated_commands: Compare exact and whitespace-normalized shell payload internally; only aggregate repetition counts are exported.
method.model_counting: Gateway requests/count_requests increment at reservation before pacing/count HTTP/inference. Actual upstream inference sends and per-request timing are unrecorded; completed responses establish a lower bound.

pacing.note: Sticky last_error snapshots prove at least one local queue expiry, not one expiry per repeated snapshot. A Codex429 event alone does not identify upstream versus local gateway rejection.

hypotheses.claim: Repeated large instruction/contract reads may contribute context and tool-output overhead.
Pacing/model waits may explain parts of the non-command event gaps.

limits: Process and first-to-last-event envelopes contain gaps; neither establishes continuous useful activity or accepted contribution.
Matched shell intervals can include waiting and transport buffering; they are not CPU work or model inference intervals.
Command-envelope residual includes model/reasoning/queue/transport and unobserved work; it is not measured idle time.
Provider100VM first-to-last envelope consists of discrete observations; no continuous22.75minute claim.
Captured output bytes are not input/context tokens, bytes actually read from files, or billed token usage.
63 nonempty patches and command/write-like events are not accepted feature delivery.
Two started command items lacked completed events and are excluded from matched complete intervals; the observed peak is not an upper bound on actual concurrent commands.
Explicit repeated document references can be reads of distinct sections, searches or truncated output; no full-file reread is inferred from a path mention.
Source hashes are evidence hashes, not credential hashes; account finance, thread/sandbox/auth identities and raw logs remain private.
